purpose: Catalog of bundled demo artifacts used by the DueCare workbench. Source case bundles are uploaded for processing/extraction; knowledge files are pre-existing KnowledgeObject envelopes for import/export/share flows.

entries.name: case_files_streamlined_demo.zip
entries.label: Streamlined five-document Bulk File Review demo
entries.demo_story: Small synthetic PH-HK fee-camouflage, provider-choice, salary-deduction, and retaliation-risk case for showing the end-to-end Bulk File Review path.
entries.privacy_note: Synthetic demo material. No real worker case files.

entries.privacy_note: Synthetic demo material. No real worker case files.
